title: Sharp arithmetic separation in chiral Padovan histories
summary: Sixteen compared statements establish quantitative recurrence for the actual infinite Padovan prefix path and compare cubic and quartic arithmetic record windows. For 0 =1, and Padovan substitution stages attain equality at arbitrarily large clocks. The full cubic record window is relatively dense with uniformly discrete differences; the identical positive-real window in the quartic case admits nonzero inverse-unit points arbitrarily close to zero, while its other real embedding grows. Scalar prefix coordinates factor the included faithful chiral timelike history in the genuine quartic trace…
